title: Vast updates grid
description: A warm-grey band with a 48px title and a dark 'More updates' button on the same line, then a grid of news cards: a square photo, a small mono line (category, an orange square, the date in capitals) and a 20px headline. One column on phones, three on desktop with 60px gaps. Each photo eases from slightly zoomed to full size as it scrolls into view.
notes: photos are slots (square); empty they show flat moon-rock placeholders
the zoom-in uses CSS scroll-driven animation; without support the photos just sit at full size
uses the theme's card colour as the band, so it contrasts with a warm-white page
name: vastspace-updates
